items.stem: Object-level org-wide default for an object is Private. What is the most appropriate way to give a specific group broader read access to those records?

options.text: Create a sharing rule (or use roles/permission sets) to open access for that group
options.rationale: Correct: with Private OWD, sharing rules, role hierarchy or sharing-granting mechanisms widen access.
Field-level security controls fields, not record visibility.
Deleting the role hierarchy removes, not grants, access.

options.text: Set the OWD to Private more strictly
options.rationale: That narrows access further, the opposite of the goal.

items.explanation: Correct: with Private OWD, sharing rules, role hierarchy or sharing-granting mechanisms widen access.

items.stem: You need to update a field on the same record before it is saved, with no external callout. Which is the most efficient choice?

options.rationale: Correct: a before-save record-triggered flow updates same-record fields efficiently without an extra DML.

options.text: A scheduled flow that runs nightly
options.rationale: A nightly schedule does not update the record at save time.
A screen flow needs user interaction; it is not for automatic before-save updates.
An outbound message sends data externally; it does not set a field before save.

items.explanation: Correct: a before-save record-triggered flow updates same-record fields efficiently without an extra DML.

items.stem: Select TWO practices that support a safe deployment of configuration changes to a Salesforce production org.

options.text: Testing changes in a sandbox before deploying
options.rationale: Correct: validating in a sandbox reduces the risk of breaking production.

options.text: Using change sets or a deployment tool to migrate metadata
options.rationale: Correct: change sets / deployment tools provide a controlled migration path.

options.text: Editing automation directly in production during business hours
options.rationale: Direct production edits are risky and bypass testing.

options.text: Deleting the sandbox before validating the change
options.rationale: Removing the test environment defeats safe deployment.
Skipping backups increases risk during deployment.

items.explanation: Correct: validating in a sandbox reduces the risk of breaking production.
